The Town Events Advisory Committee hosts a Magical Storytime with Santa and Mrs. Claus in the Town Hall Board Room, then the town lights its tree at Town Hall with a visit from Santa and Mrs. Claus, The Pop Stop 37135 and the Nolensville High School Choir. faq: What does Nolensville do for Christmas?

The Town of Nolensville holds a Magical Storytime with Santa and Mrs. Claus, a tree lighting at Town Hall and a Holiday Parade down Nolensville Road, all in the first weekend of December. The Nolensville Branch Library adds a Toddler Story Time with Santa earlier in the week.
Does Nolensville have a Christmas parade?

Yes. The Nolensville Holiday Parade begins at Rolling Hills Community Church and runs straight down Nolensville Road, through the Historic District, ending on Nolensville Park Road. The town asks that no candy or other handouts be thrown along the route for safety.
Where is the Nolensville tree lighting?

At Nolensville Town Hall on Nolensville Road. The town's holiday page lists a visit from Santa and Mrs. Claus, The Pop Stop 37135, a coffee food truck and the Nolensville High School Choir as part of the evening. It follows Storytime with Santa and Mrs. Claus, which starts at 6 pm the same night in the Board Room.
Can kids meet Santa in Nolensville?

Yes. Santa and Mrs. Claus tell festive stories at the town's storytime in the Town Hall Board Room and make a special visit to the tree lighting. The Nolensville Branch Library also hosts a Toddler Story Time with Santa earlier in the week. Space at the storytime is limited and seating is first come first serve.
How do I handle road closures on parade day?

The town publishes detour routes for Nolensville Road, using Kidd Road, Brittan Lane, Rocky Fork Road and Sunset Road, so check the town's holiday page before you drive. The town lists separate detours for southbound, northbound and west side traffic, so pick the one that matches your direction.
